Problem Statement:
Rajesh and Ram are comparing their highest marks from previous exams. You are given Rajesh’s marks from N exams. Help him find the maximum marks he has scored so he can prove it to Ram and win the bet. 
Input Description:
First line contains an integer N, the number of exams. Second line contains N space-separated integers representing Rajesh’s marks. 
Output Description:
A single integer representing the maximum marks obtained by Rajesh. 
Sample Input:
3
82 96 72 
Sample Output:
96
